description:
About Our Brand and Products

Inspire.me Collection is a faith-based digital brand dedicated to helping believers live from truth, peace, and spiritual authority. Our products include Scripture-anchored devotionals, formation guides, and spiritual reset resources designed to move people out of emotional cycles and into grounded, daily alignment with God.

Our flagship product, Daily Spiritual Authority: 30-Day Formation Guide, is not surface-level inspiration. It is a structured, transformational journey that combines biblical teaching, identity formation, guided practices, and reflection to create lasting spiritual change.

What Makes Us Different

Unlike traditional devotionals that focus on motivation alone, Inspire.me Collection emphasizes formation over feelings. Our resources are:

  • Scripture-anchored and identity-based

  • Designed for daily practice, not passive reading

  • Focused on spiritual authority, peace, and alignment

  • Built for believers who want depth, not hype

We don’t sell inspiration that fades—we offer tools that help people live differently.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn competitive commissions by sharing Inspire.me Collection products with their audience.

  • Commission Rate: Up to 30% per sale

  • Tier Activation: 30% commission after 10 confirmed sales

  • Tracking: Unique affiliate links provided upon approval

  • Payouts: Paid via PayPal or manual payout (based on platform setup)

There is no inventory, customer service, or fulfillment required.

How to Promote Us

Affiliates may promote Inspire.me Collection through:

  • Social media posts and reels

  • YouTube videos or descriptions

  • Email newsletters

  • Blogs or ministry platforms

  • Personal recommendations and testimonials

Approved affiliates receive guidance on messaging, positioning, and ethical promotion. We ask that all promotions remain truthful, respectful, and aligned with our faith-based values.

Other Information

  • Digital products only (instant delivery)

  • No refunds due to the nature of digital content

  • Affiliate approval is required to maintain brand alignment

  • We reserve the right to remove affiliates who misrepresent the brand

By partnering with Inspire.me Collection, affiliates become part of a mission-driven movement focused on spiritual growth, peace, and transformation.
payout_period: Payouts are processed monthly between the 1st–5th after a 14-day holding period to verify completed transactions. Minimum payout is $50. Payments are issued via PayPal or approved manual payout methods.
